items.title: Bitter feud ensues after landlord's failed attempt to raise tenants' rent 65%
items.description: A New Brunswick tenant and his landlord have been in a bitter year-long dispute that involves a 65 per cent rent increase, a failed eviction attempt, and claims that the rental unit, a bungalow, is needed to house the owner's aging mother-in-law.
